  When a charge fails, retry it on days 1, 3, 7, 14 after the failure (contractual, finance policy FP-12). If the day-14 retry also fails, mark the invoice `uncollectible` and stop. Never retry an invoice that has a refund in progress.

**WeasyPrint renders the invoice PDFs, and you change the font in the CSS string in `src/billing/pdf.py`.**

@font-face { font-family: Inter; src: url(assets/Inter.woff2); } body { font-family: Inter; }
```

To use a different font, change the `@font-face` source and the `body { font-family }` rule.

**Likely cause of the wrong font:** `assets/Inter.woff2` doesn't exist in the repo. I found no `.woff`/`.woff2` file anywhere and no `assets/` directory. I haven't run the renderer, so this is unconfirmed. To fix it, add the font file and pass `base_url` pointing at the directory that holds `assets/`. Alternatively, use an absolute `file://` path in the CSS.
